releaseTitle: v1.5.0 - Received Streak Analysis & Avatar-Offset OCR Fix
releaseNotes:
• Fixed received message misdetection in avatar-offset apps (Instagram, Messenger, Tinder, Bumble, Hinge)
• Fixed prose delivery keywords ('read', 'sent') falsely marking received messages as sent
• Relaxed bottom crop margin so received messages near the input bar are always captured
• Added automatic multi-message received streak grouping & cohesive AI streak replies
• Added 1-tap 'Reply to Full Received Streak' option in overlay & analysis screen
